A <br> inside an inline code span splits the span and emits a hard break

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<p>X <code>A<br>B<br>C</code></p>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
